compatibility: Additive offline contract. Existing v1 schemas, questionnaire data, readers, writers and customer behavior remain unchanged. V2 is not imported by the active runtime.
forward: Preserve the complete v1 Owner Program payload and its deterministic source hash
Map v1 space, relationship, zoning, furniture, accessibility and priority fields without deletion
Split migrated accessibility owner preference/needs from regulatory applicability provenance; keep applicability UNKNOWN
Import unit types and units-per-floor only from an explicitly supplied v1 Generation Input
Mark all migrated provenance UNKNOWN_LEGACY_SOURCE with verification_status UNKNOWN
Report MATERIAL_INPUT_NOT_PRESENT when canonical unit-program data is absent
Require complete canonical units, verified compatible material provenance, independently supplied current site/national/local bindings and evidence-backed geometry before resolved-input qualification
Bind geometry evidence to a deterministic identity of the exact program, unit program, site and authority snapshots
consumers: offline Architecture Owner Program research and future explicitly approved adapters
loss_policy: Never discard or infer a legacy value. Preserve the original payload and emit structured findings for absent or ambiguous material inputs.
stale_policy: Any changed owner-program identity, unit program, questionnaire content, resolution status, site/national/local identity/version/reference/hash, or geometry evidence-input dependency invalidates or fail-closes the resolved input.
deprecation_window: No v1 deprecation is scheduled. V1 remains readable and writable until a separately approved activation and consumer migration.
deployment: No staging or production deployment, database migration, runtime import or Generator activation is authorized.
rollback: Revert the additive v2 commit. V1 remains the unchanged active contract and no production data requires reversal.
